en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing the main entrance of a spa or sanatorium complex. A gatehouse stands on the left and a larger multi‑storey building with a small dome and many windows is on the right, behind a fence and gateway. A man in uniform stands on the street in front of the entrance. The title text at the top reads "Bad Gottleuba Haupteingang," and smaller text on the gatehouse appears to read "Heilstätte …".
